visual_action: The video starts with a split screen. On the right, Donald Trump is speaking at a podium. On the left, an unidentified man with gray hair listens with a serious expression. A chyron from 'NOTICIAS Univision' is at the bottom. The video then cuts to a montage of violent scenes from the January 6th Capitol attack, including rioters clashing with police, pushing through barricades, breaking windows, and chanting inside a building. One shot shows a makeshift gallows erected outside. The video concludes by returning to the initial split-screen shot of Trump speaking.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown speaking, identified by face, and is the central subject of the on-screen text and the video's argument.

cast.name: Mike Pence
cast.evidence: On-screen text shows the crowd's chant, 'Hang Mike Pence!'

cast.name: unnamed man
cast.evidence: An unidentified man is shown in a split screen reacting to Donald Trump's speech.

cast.name: Univision
cast.evidence: The logo 'NOTICIAS Univision' appears on the chyron.

on_screen_text.text: Donald Trump says NOTHING was wrong about the attack on the Capitol !!💔

spoken_summary: Donald Trump is heard saying, 'I said peacefully and patriotically. Nothing done wrong, at all, nothing done wrong.' His words 'nothing done wrong' are then repeated with an audio distortion effect. This is followed by a crowd chanting 'Hang Mike Pence!'. At the end, Trump's voice returns, saying, 'That was a day of love.'
audio_music: The video begins with a calm, gentle piano track under Trump's voice. A record-scratch sound effect is used to distort and repeat his words. When the montage of the riot begins, the music switches to a tense, dramatic, and ominous orchestral score. The sounds of the chaotic crowd, including shouting and chanting, are also prominent during the montage.
editing_pacing: The video uses a split-screen format to show Trump speaking and a man reacting. It then cuts to a fast-paced montage of violent riot footage. Large, kinetic text overlays appear word-by-word to emphasize what is being said by Trump and the crowd.
central_claim: Donald Trump falsely characterizes the violent January 6th Capitol attack as peaceful and loving, a claim which is directly contradicted by footage of the event.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as dishonest and dismissive of political violence, thereby encouraging opposition to him.
